casePolicy.scope: New external audio introduced for the koto research and comparison work only; not a permanent ban on other licenses or a removal rule for existing assets.
casePolicy.authority: Autonomous in-scope adoption when provenance, rights, ethics and quality satisfy the documented gates; no project-owner preapproval gate.

roles.creator: RutgerMuller
roles.recordist: RutgerMuller (inferred from upload and first-person recording description; sole recorder not independently established)

licenseEvidence.method: Exa full-page read plus direct public HTML inspection; timestamp records completion of retrieval after the label check
licenseEvidence.shortRecord: Individual sound page links CC0 1.0; creator profile confirms CC0, requests creative transformation and no misleading collaboration credit. Public share-url metadata links the high-quality MP3 preview; original WAV download requires login.

confirmedScope: Uploader explicitly identifies own improvised koto performance; CC0 selected for this recording.
Creator profile and official biography independently describe publishing own field recordings under CC0.
rights.basis: Individual CC0 1.0 statement, first-person performance/recording description, creator profile and official biography provide a reasonable basis for the specified transformed single notes. No whole improvisation, distinctive phrase or original performance timing is reused. This is not a warranty of sole rights or verified thirteen-string instrumentation.

thirdParty.composition: Uploader describes own improvisation; no named third-party composition or commercial source is declared. Distinctive phrases will not be copied into the independent score.
thirdParty.performance: Uploader explicitly describes being the player. No other performer is credited for these sessions.
thirdParty.recording: Zoom H2n stereo MS, mid-October 2016, Kashiwa, Chiba, Japan, microphone under instrument, according to uploader. Sole recording authorship is not independently proved.
thirdParty.otherRights: No third-party library or commercial source is declared. Selected cuts were screened for a dominant single-note harmonic event after a quiet interval. Human verification of absence of speech, other music and third-party performance has not been performed; no concrete contrary sign was identified in the source description and automatic screen.
thirdParty.intent: Profile requests creative transformation; discourages commercial redistribution of unedited sounds and misleading collaboration credit. Treat these as ethical requests separately from CC0 conditions.
thirdParty.conclusion: The specified single-note cuts, bounded time modifications and independently authored score/FIR use remain within the reviewed CC0 and creator remix intent. No whole improvisation, distinctive phrase or original timing is reused. Human contamination listening, sole recording ownership, thirteen-string identity and calibrated recording layers remain unverified. Remove an affected cut and regenerate dependent audio if concrete third-party contamination is later identified.

usage.purpose: Shared pitch-rate/press/damping sampler for the original note studies, historical hybrid and the current four-root recorded-sustain pipeline; no original improvisation phrase is replayed.
Loads and hash-checks the distributed bank, decodes mono notes, and renders sample/hybrid comparative study cases through the shared independently authored performance inputs.
Offline extraction from retained SHA-256-locked preview decodes; writes the five processed note WAVs and bank metadata with exact source-frame correspondence. No network or original-WAV acquisition.
Defines the independently authored tuning, 39-second note events and shared comparison cases passed to sample/hybrid renderers; it supplies performance inputs and does not load recorded audio itself.

Current offline sample-sustain-color generation from the four processed recorded roots at48kHz, followed by the self-authored bounded relative excitation FIR, independently authored39-second score, common gain and deterministic24-bit TPDF dither; old hybrid96 generation is preserved as historical evidence.
Runtime lazy loading and decoding of the bundled generated koto-performance.wav derived from these processed note sources; no runtime request to the original recording service.

Prepares the additional 240 Hz note from already-reviewed source365242 at38.769-39.580s/channel0 with hash-locked decode, DC removal, fades and the original common gain; defines the six-root comparison input.
Offline bounded atempo tail processing, four-root selection and independently authored note/score studies; preserves raw and intermediate provenance, with no copied improvisation phrase.
Self-authored relative excitation-color FIR after sample rendering; uses a bounded tau-versus-velocity design assumption, not measured recording velocity layers or an identified body IR.

quality.evidence: Distributed cuts match bank SHA-256, bytes, frames and 48 kHz mono PCM16. Their early harmonic-energy screen spans 0.984551-0.999108; this does not prove isolated performance, absence of speech or naturalness. Same-input rebuild is byte-identical as recorded in the processing document.
limitations: Lossy incomplete official MP3 preview, not the original 96 kHz/24-bit WAV.
Thirteen-string instrument not verified; one uncontrolled recording/force condition, no measured velocity layers or round robins.
Several cuts have deliberately shortened tails; pure sample playback is limited to ±5 semitones including press, with A3/B-flat3 unavailable.
Human final-quality and third-party-contamination listening not performed.
Acquisition redownload not reproduced; preserved input and hash-locked processing are the reproducibility basis.
Finite atempo tail processing is a disclosed time modification, not a recovered natural future.
The relative excitation FIR is self-authored from an assumed tau-velocity relation; no measured velocity layer or identified body impulse response.
The owner ended the current improvement turn; this is not human final-quality acceptance.
quality.humanListeningScope: The isolated source cuts and absence of third-party contamination have not received a human verification. Owner feedback on earlier rendered candidates is recorded separately and did not grant final timbre acceptance.
quality.currentDelivery: Current-turn delivery at the owner-requested stopping point; no final naturalness, consistent-koto-timbre or measured-velocity-layer certification.
quality.recordingLayers: One uncontrolled recorded layer; instrument/microphone/force and recording-session relationship are not independently calibrated.

uncertainties: Thirteen strings not verified.
Sole recording authorship not independently proved; first-person source and explicit CC0 are the reasonable provenance basis.
No controlled velocity layers or round robins declared.
Original WAV unavailable without account login; no credential use or bypass attempted.
Human listening for speech, other music, third-party performance and naturalness is pending; harmonic screening is not proof of their absence.
The adopted files are specified transformed notes only; original recording and distinctive improvisation phrases are not distributed.
Strict-prefix redownload failed within bounded attempts; same-input processing reproduction succeeded.
Cross-session instrument, microphone, tuning and performer-force equivalence are not independently established.
The additional 240 Hz root uses the same reviewed source365242; periodic/odd-series screening is acoustic evidence, not new rights clearance.
Owner agreement to finish this turn is distinct from final human timbre-quality acceptance.
sources.adoptionScope: Rights and ethics accepted for the specified prepared notes, finite time-modified stems, reproducibility inputs and independently authored score output from the same two reviewed CC0 sources. The owner requested completion of the current improvement turn; no final human tone-quality acceptance is implied.
